cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Admit You’re Hurt
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit hurt, fear, or disappointment before you reveal that you feel it too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. When Mum cancelled our birthday dinner, were you disappointed? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'd like your answer before I give mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I cried in the supermarket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Me too. I told the cashier the birthday candles were seasonal allergies.

mechanism: A organizes a replacement birthday celebration but negotiates reciprocal disclosure so B admits hurt before A acknowledges sharing it.
confusable: Unlike simply asking about B mood, A delays A own matching admission; confidence depends on B agreeing to answer first.
comparison: Sibling disappointment after a cancelled dinner differs from coworkers negotiating exposure in a complaint.
seedUse: D112-a shared birthday cancellation and supermarket tears; S02-a manages the sequence while conceding B request for reciprocity.
